race.comment: SHARE THE MUSIC (5) turned in an eye-catching run last time out over 1318m at Geelong, charging home from well back to finish a neck away in second. Is yet to miss the frame from three starts this campaign, including a win. No reason to think he doesn't run well again. ZETHEROS (8) resumed over 1200m at Warrnambool where he showed little early speed but got home nicely to finish fourth, beaten 3 lengths. Sure to be tough to hold out. MELODEE ROSE (12) did well to score two runs ago then turned in a nice run last time out when fourth over 1200m at Donald, beaten just over a length. Best figures measure up so deserves another chance. LIM'S IDA (2) has contested much. much tougher races than this and while he is a light of his best days, last start was too bad to be true and he did win the run prior, so give another chance. REGAL SURGE (3) is at his best over a little further than this, but could show up if a recent trial win is anything to go by.
